section.title: Customer Journey
section.purpose: Map the end-to-end customer/beneficiary path and its failure points.

questions.title: Acquisition
questions.prompt: How do prospects or beneficiaries first discover the company?

questions.title: Lead capture
questions.prompt: Where does a new lead, inquiry, application, donor or case first enter the system?
questions.recommendation: Identify source system and trigger event.

questions.title: Qualification
questions.prompt: How does the company decide which opportunities to pursue?
questions.recommendation: Capture explicit rules and unwritten judgment.

questions.title: Conversion
questions.prompt: What happens between qualification and commitment/payment?
questions.recommendation: Map calls, demos, proposals, approvals, contracts and payment.

questions.title: Customer onboarding
questions.prompt: What must happen immediately after commitment?
questions.recommendation: Identify handoffs, data collection, account setup and expectations.

questions.title: Fulfillment
questions.prompt: How is the promised value delivered?

questions.title: Support
questions.prompt: How are questions, complaints, incidents or change requests handled?
questions.recommendation: Identify queues, escalation and knowledge sources.

questions.title: Retention / referral
questions.prompt: How do customers renew, repeat, refer, donate again or expand?

questions.title: Journey failure points
questions.prompt: Where do customers get delayed, confused, lost, ignored, refunded or disappointed?

questions.title: Moments of truth
questions.prompt: Which interactions most affect trust, conversion, retention or reputation?
questions.recommendation: These usually deserve stronger human oversight.
